Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a complete white-out of the left hemithorax with the mediastinum (trachea and heart) shifted to the right, away from the affected side. This shift indicates a space-occupying process like a massive pleural effusion or tension pneumothorax, rather than volume loss (collapse/consolidation), which would pull the mediastinum towards the affected side.
